nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name' storing the token name 'VillageOfThousands'.
Public string state variable 'symbol' storing the token symbol 'VOT'.
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals' set to 18 for token precision.
uint256 state variable '_totalSupply' holding the initial minted supply of 55000000000000000000000000.
Mapping 'balances' from address to uint tracking token balances of each holder.
Nested mapping 'allowed' from owner to spender to allowance amount used by approve/transferFrom.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and transfer origin.
constructor() initializes name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and credits all tokens to msg.sender.
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) view returning balances[tokenOwner].
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approve(address spender, uint tokens) sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transfer(address to, uint tokens) moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) deducts balances and allowance without verifying the allowance is sufficient.
safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure, checks c = a + b does not overflow via require(c >= a).
safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure, requires b <= a and returns a - b.
safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure, computes a * b and validates via require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure, requires b > 0 before dividing a / b.
Unchecked uint256 subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply() which can underflow.
transferFrom() decreases allowed[from][msg.sender] without checking allowance >= tokens, allowing allowance to underflow/revert and unauthorized deductions.

edges.reason: constructor assigns the literal 'VillageOfThousands' to the name state variable.
constructor assigns the literal 'VOT' to the symbol state variable.
constructor assigns 18 to the decimals state variable.
constructor writes the initial supply value into _totalSupply.
constructor credits _totalSupply to balances[msg.sender].
constructor uses msg.sender as the balance owner key when minting tokens.
totalSupply() reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply() reads balances[address(0)] from the balances mapping.
totalSupply() executes the unchecked subtraction represented by the unsafe operation node.
The unchecked subtraction consumes _totalSupply, creating a possible uint256 underflow.
The unchecked subtraction consumes balances[address(0)], so a non-zero value can underflow the result.
balanceOf() reads the balances mapping for the requested owner.
allowance() reads the nested allowed mapping.
approve() writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approve() keys the allowance on the caller-controlled msg.sender, making authorization caller dependent.
transfer() reads and writes balances for msg.sender and the recipient.
transfer() debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller-controlled address determines the source of funds.
transfer() calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer() calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom() reads and writes the balances mapping for 'from' and 'to'.
transferFrom() writes allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is consumed, so authorization depends on the caller.
transferFrom() calls safeSub to debit balances and the allowance.
transferFrom() calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom() reaches the unsafe operation of deducting the allowance without verifying allowance >= tokens.
